adhd.label: Step 1 · Jumps to Ch. 3: Winning Whole Without Fighting (Start Here)
adhd.brief: Starts with Sun Tzu's highest principle: breaking resistance without ever fighting a draining battle, keeping your own energy and peace 100% intact.

adhd.label: Step 2 · Jumps to Ch. 6: Emptiness and Fullness — Flowing Like Water
adhd.brief: Shows how water never crashes into a solid rock wall—it effortlessly flows around high resistance into empty spaces, shaping its victory to the terrain.

adhd.label: Step 3 · Jumps Back to Ch. 1 & 4: Making Yourself Invincible First
adhd.brief: Returns to Master Sun's opening rule: you cannot control when an opponent makes a mistake, but you can make your own position completely unshakable first.
